panels.title: Infected Files
panels.description: Total infected files ever detected. Any value > 0 requires immediate investigation.

panels.title: Nodes with Infections
panels.description: Distinct nodes that reported at least one infected file.

panels.title: Partial Results
panels.description: Scans where log parsing failed — results may be incomplete. Re-run if > 0.

panels.title: Infections Detected Over Time
panels.description: Infected files detected per scan event per node. Each bar = one scan that found malware.

panels.title: Node Freshness
panels.description: Time since last successful scan per node. Green <24 h, Yellow 24–48 h, Red >48 h.

panels.title: Running
panels.description: NodeScans currently executing.

panels.title: Completed
panels.description: Total successful NodeScans.

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Total failed NodeScans.

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Percentage of scans that completed successfully.

panels.title: Total Files Scanned
panels.description: Cumulative files scanned since operator start.

panels.title: Schedules Run
panels.description: Total ScanSchedule trigger executions.

panels.title: Scan Results / Period
panels.description: Completed and failed NodeScans per time period.

panels.title: Concurrent Scans
panels.description: Number of scans running simultaneously. Spikes indicate scheduling pressure.

panels.title: Scan Duration — p50 / p95
panels.description: Scan duration per node. Wide p50–p95 gap signals outlier nodes or large filesystem variance.

panels.title: Files per Scan / Node
panels.description: Files scanned per node per scan event. Each spike = one completed scan.

panels.title: Avg Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: Average % of files skipped because unchanged since last scan. Red < 30 %, Green > 60 %.

panels.title: Files Skipped
panels.description: Cumulative files skipped by incremental scanning.

panels.title: Time Saved
panels.description: Cumulative seconds saved by skipping unchanged files.

panels.title: Cache Size
panels.description: Total size of all incremental scan caches on disk.

panels.title: Cached Files
panels.description: Total number of file entries tracked across all node caches.

panels.title: Scanned vs Skipped / Node
panels.description: Per scan: files scanned (solid) vs files skipped by incremental cache (dashed). Large skip = efficient cache.

panels.title: Active ClusterScans
panels.description: Node counts per ClusterScan. Green = Completed, Red = Failed.

panels.title: Sent
panels.description: Total notification attempts (all channels).

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Notification delivery failures after all retries.

panels.title: Notifications Over Time
panels.description: Notification attempts vs failures per channel over time.
